propositions: Normal compaction, fsck rebuild, and crash recovery each independently re-derive candidate listing, snapshot detection, snapshot envelope construction, retired source restoration, and commit logic, creating maintenance burden and inconsistency risk.

The snapshot envelope builder exists in two separate locations with identical structure and keys (source_event_uuids, compacted_at), and the is_snapshot_path test is inlined three different ways across modules.
The retired source restoration rule (conditional deletion of uncommitted SNAPSHOT only after all renames succeed) is duplicated across three crash/recovery paths with inconsistent git reset handling.

A stray non-JSON file in a ticket directory is incorrectly included in source_event_uuids and renamed to *.retired by the rebuild because candidate filtering does not consistently require the .json suffix.

Extract shared compaction derivations into a new compact_plan module with consolidated Candidate, snapshot detection, envelope building, and retirement logic routed through all three compaction paths (normal fold, rebuild, recovery).
